adversarial_findings.description: KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1576 uses `$t('label.kds_status_conflict')` but the key only exists under `message.*` namespace in all 3 language files (fr/en/ar). Same component at line 2190 uses the correct `message.kds_status_conflict`. When kdsErrorBanner is triggered by status_conflict path, end users see raw text 'label.kds_status_conflict'. This is the kind of CLAUDE.md §6 'raw label' regression visual mandate is built to catch.
adversarial_findings.rec: Inline 1-line fix — `label.` → `message.`. Add Vitest assertion that translates the key non-null.

adversarial_findings.description: 7 components inline-duplicate `subscribeEcho/unsubscribeEcho` boilerplate (PosComponent, KitchenDisplaySystemComponent, StockRuptureDashboardComponent, PreparingAndReadyComponent, PosOrdersTrackerComponent, KioskAppComponent — frozen, KioskWaitingComponent). Each is ~30-50 LOC of identical try/catch + leaveChannel + .listen + Pusher subscription_error binding. A `useEchoChannel(channelName, handlerMap)` composable would remove ~250 LOC of duplication and centralize the defensive-pre-unsubscribe pattern. Same for polling: 20 components inline-duplicate `setInterval/clearInterval/beforeUnmount` — `usePolling(fn, ms)` composable would replace 20 boilerplate clusters. Not a V1 blocker — current code is clean (0 ghost subscribers, 0 polling-without-cleanup) but tech-debt density high.
adversarial_findings.rec: V1.0.2 backlog item — extract `useEchoChannel` + `usePolling` composables. Migrate non-frozen components first. Frozen components (KioskAppComponent, KioskWizardComponent, KioskUpsellComponent, PaymentComponent, PosV5TrancheRow) defer to next-frozen-zone-cycle owner gate.

Polling discipline CLEAN (20/20 with cleanup, 0 without — M-POS-4 N-HEAL-04 confirmed landed at PosComponent commit 385f77288).
